summary: Completed comprehensive testing of WhatsApp Leads Dashboard at /marketing/leads/whatsapp/. All features working correctly. Backend returns correct data, UI displays properly with all KPIs, charts, Performance by Sales Number table, and leads table.
seed_data_creation: 15 WhatsApp leads distributed across 3 WabisNumbers (Sales Team 1, Sales Team 2, Support Line) were pre-created by main agent
context_for_next_testing_agent: WhatsApp Leads Dashboard fully tested and working. All features implemented: KPIs (Total: 15, Pending: 4, Won: 7, Lost: 4), Performance by Sales Number table with 3 numbers, All WhatsApp Leads table with status badges, date filter (all options working), and click-to-filter by sales number row.

kpis_section.details: Shows Total (15), Pending (4), Won (7), Lost (4), Conv. Rate (63.6%), Revenue (32,800)

performance_by_sales_number_table.details: Shows 3 numbers (Sales Team 1, Sales Team 2, Support Line) with correct stats per number

each_number_row_stats.details: Each row shows leads count, pending, won, lost, conversion rate, and revenue

all_whatsapp_leads_table.details: Shows individual leads with name, phone, sales number, status badges (Won/Lost/Pending), attribution, value, created date

date_filter.details: Tested today, yesterday, this_week, this_month, last_7_days, last_30_days - all working

click_number_row_filter.details: Clicking Sales Team 1 row filters leads to only that number, shows 'Filtered Leads' heading and 'Clear' link

charts.details: Conversion Funnel (bar), Lead Source (doughnut), Daily Leads Trend (line) all display correctly

verification_method.backend: Django test client with pytest - 14 tests covering access, KPIs, tables, filtering
verification_method.frontend: Playwright browser automation - logged in, navigated to page, verified all elements, tested interactions
